label: Book III. — Chapter II.—Against Embellishing the Body. (part 2)

blocks.text: angels, who renounced the beauty of God for a beauty which fades, and so fell from heaven to earth.[^n1594]
The Shechemites, too, were punished by an overthrow for dishonouring the holy virgin. The grave was their punishment, and the monument of their ignominy leads to salvation.

n1594.text: Gen. vi. 1, 2. [It is surprising with what tenacity this interpretation clings to the ancient mind of the Church. The Nephilim and Gibborim need a special investigation. The Oriental tales of the genii are probably connected with their fabulous history.]
